name: What should I look for in a contractor for a master bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a contractor for a master bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for a master bathroom remodel, prioritize those with proven experience in similar projects, strong references, proper licensing, and comprehensive insurance. A good contractor should provide a clear, detailed proposal, communicate effectively, and demonstrate a commitment to quality craftsmanship. It's also beneficial to choose a local company like Hometelligent Inc., as they will be familiar with local building codes and have established relationships with local suppliers, streamlining the project execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a contractor with experience, strong references, proper licensing, and insurance. A clear proposal and effective communication are key. Local contractors like Hometelligent Inc. offer familiarity with local codes and suppliers.
